text: QC2-001 answered by the handler under J's delegation of 23:26 Berlin: serving sections is acceptable and the one packet stands as built; two parts would change the instrument, which is J's call. Two things owed: list the ten parts of model-p3.md not served, by heading, in review-C2.md above the instruction, saying the reader saw sections of model-p3.md and not the whole file; and in the check leg, read every error the reviewer reports against the whole model-p3.md, unserved sections included, before accepting or refusing it, answering by pointing to the text where the unserved text already answers it. The assumption the build rested on holds; nothing is rebuilt.

Close of C2b (the reviewer's build). One packet, out/_packets-C2/C2-reviewer.md (51,116 bytes, sha256 08c64c7ae25ac29ccd164b57a01c36848fa190412219b4d74598e7351fc6bfbd): the instruction verbatim, three sections of model-p3.md verbatim (prose, elements, arrows), story-p3.md whole, the criterion paragraph, the tiers with every third-order theme by name, the read verbs. Ten parts of model-p3.md not served, listed by heading in review-C2.md above the instruction (QC2-001: sections acceptable, the one packet stands). RETURN-C2.md written; run_manifest.json stage C2 entry appended. model-p3.md unchanged since the build (sha256 aa75ee6c6230348f916b1e2fa6f2eacf0864d5f1750d657d5d5a21a005011b3e, checked at the close). Head rewritten (2,990 words, counted; no element ids). validate.py C2: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Closing with done.sh C2 --cut packets-out; next, after the dispatch, the check leg C2c, which reads every reported error against the whole model-p3.md.

C2c opened (the reviewer's check and the mid-stage interview, stage C2 section 6). Oriented: head, stage file, diary, validate.py --open C2 (0 errors). QC2-001 read before the first write: serving sections stands, and every reported error is read against the whole model-p3.md before it is accepted or refused; the assumption the build rested on held, so nothing built on it changes. The reader's file: out/_fleet_raw/C2/C2-reviewer/r1.jsonl, one valid return (reissue 0, served claude-opus-5-5 via cli, packet sha256 08c64c7a... as built), its served digest aa75ee6c6230348f916b1e2fa6f2eacf0864d5f1750d657d5d5a21a005011b3e equal to model-p3.md as it stands. It reports 9 errors (order 3, quote 1, contradiction 4, count 1) and a partition of 196 third-order themes into 28 groups, T3-017 unplaced. Contract rule 13 read: an error is fixed; a disagreement is answered, kept beside the claim where the argument still favours it.

Reviewer's errors fixed in model/arrows.jsonl (contract rule 13; move relating or contrasting), by out/_analysis/c2c_fix_arrows.py, quotes, items and hours read from the store; 4 model/history.jsonl lines with the old lines as was (history now 58 lines, arrows 20, counted). A02 (error 2, quote): the instances answered a start with an enrolment ('I'm in.', 'I'm on my way!'), not a call; replaced by opticgaming c0191 -> c0192 and kerbalspaceprogram c0026 -> c0028, starts answered by a call in rooms where the order holds; the count stands (the first P01 concept reads as an enrolment in at most 10 of 64 holding rooms, c2c_t3002_enrolments.txt). A04 (error 3, order): switzerland's pair invokes a treaty made earlier and DestinyTheGame's room fails the order; replaced by unturned c0059 -> c0060 and adventuretime c0064 -> c0065 (orders checked). A05 (error 4): the printed instance ubc c0084 is one uncited turn; the support rests on asktransgender c0003 -> c0004. A20 (error 5): transformers is recorded as a mechanism failure (order holds, the line names no flood); the post-close judgment of the canvas's worth enters the bound and the counterexample response; A20 stays strong. The prose of model-p3.md is not edited (the reviewer's served digest must keep matching); the prose fixes go into model-p4.md and story-p4.md at C2d-01.

F-010 superseded by a bounded line (rule 14; findings.jsonl now 15 lines, 12 findings, counted): the statement stands on 132 of 155 rooms; the bound gains the post-close judgment of the canvas's worth (transformers, h80.40, names no flood), from the reviewer's error 5; refuted_by now stated (a room where the host sub's first line answers no call or flood while the canvas runs). F-012 checked against error 7 and left as it stands: it says the six hosts have an empty pre-event brief, not that the canvas founded them.

notes-C2.md: the reviewer's check written, every item answered under rule 13. Errors: A01 refused (metroid c0002 is cited under building and reporting and reports a placed piece); A02 accepted (instances were joining lines; fixed; the count stands); A04 accepted in part (instances replaced; switzerland's room-level order holds, first upkeep h5.38, first treaty talk h18.62); A05 accepted (one uncited turn; fixed on asktransgender's transition); A20 accepted (transformers a mechanism failure; fixed; F-010 superseded); A10 accepted in part (the story's tag; the bound is a scope condition, not an absorption); the founded hosts accepted (empty brief does not show founding); bounds tagged as uses accepted; the Present count accepted (it counts rooms where the order fails, not the stricter clause). Ledger fixes now, prose fixes in model-p4.md and story-p4.md at C2d-01. Partition read (c2c_partition_compare.txt): adjusted Rand 0.661, six fourth-order themes kept exactly, ten more at Jaccard 0.7 or above, 38 of 197 third-order themes moved; the tier is determined where the arrows are and under-determined where pass 3's residues are. Hosting with space accepted as a recut declared for C2d-01's first move (T3-035, T3-094, T3-099, T3-162 from Meta-organization to Territoriality); relocation with efficacy and reconciliation apart refused; identity by activity kept beside the claim; the host sub by actor taken as a test.

out/interview/C2c.md written (the mid-stage interview, under 800 words, counted): what the reader found (nine errors in three groups; a 28-group partition, adjusted Rand 0.661 against the tier), what I accept (six errors in full, two in part; the hosting recut), what I refuse and why (A01; switzerland's reverse order; A10's bound as absorption; relocation into efficacy; reconciliation apart; the identity split kept beside the claim), and what the final passes will change.

Close of C2c (the reviewer's check and the mid-stage interview). The reviewer's return copied into review-C2.md; its served digest equals model-p3.md (aa75ee6c..., unchanged at the close). Nine errors answered under rule 13 after reading the whole model-p3.md (QC2-001): six accepted in full, two in part, one refused; ledger fixes made (A02, A04, A05, A20 in arrows.jsonl, 4 history lines, snap C2-move-relating-42; F-010 superseded by a bounded line), prose fixes carried to model-p4.md and story-p4.md at C2d-01. The partition read: adjusted Rand 0.661, determined where the arrows are, under-determined where the residues are; hosting with space accepted as a recut declared for C2d-01's first move; three divergences refused or kept beside the claim; the host sub by actor taken as a test. interview/C2c.md written (790 words, counted). Head rewritten (2,999 words, counted; no element ids). validate.py C2: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Closing with done.sh C2 --cut interview; next, C2d-01, the first closing pass.

C2d-01 opened: pass 4, the first closing pass (stage C2 section 1; the stopping rule counts from the C2c fixes; from pass 4 on the pass that best meets the criterion is kept, ties to the earlier). Oriented: head, stage file, diary, validate.py --open C2 (0 errors). The PI's message: C2c closed clean; J is back and approved the interview the handler drafted ('go ahead', 12:26 Berlin), held on a fork under J's ruling of 23:24 Berlin; J's rulings stand, QC2-001 included. The fork's points, taken as working hypotheses: the tier is determined where its groups name one act on one object and chosen where they rest on the body carried in, level or the host sub as one actor; the hosting recut with re-reads first (A19's instance and bound rooms, the two failed coalition tests, border talk or granting then hosting, F-008 and F-012); the instance rule in six checks; A20 run on rulings and objections apart before hour 73; the flag and emblem themes as an inconsistency on my side; watch the idiom rule declared before any room, the seven host rooms, the four thin arrows, the call against one-line joining, ratcheting, and no parallel writes to one file.

Pass 4 declarations written in notes-C2.md before any count: (1) the hosting recut (four hosting themes from Meta-organization to Territoriality; the coalition element narrowed; F-008, F-012 re-examined); (2) the flag and emblem rule written before a second recut (a theme whose acts draw or settle the room's own mark goes with Collective representation; one that claims or narrates the nation beyond the mark stays with Flagging the nation), applied by reading each member's gate; (3) the instance audit in six checks, a failing instance reported as failing; (4) retests after the recuts under pass 1's statement and null: upkeep, border talk and exchange then coalition on the narrowed element, border talk then hosting, A11 on the new P02, membership then attack on the new K04; (5) the host's line by actor before hour 73 (rulings, objections) with a decision rule; (6) the P01 arrows recounted without joining lines (sensitivity, rule written); (7) failure clauses counted by the second statement; (8) the idiom rule declared before any room; (9) the pass 4 story-room rule, seed 20261018; (10) the story's fixes; (11) the criterion, ties to the earlier pass.

Fourth-order recut (pass 4, declaration 1; moves splitting and merging; rule 11): the hosting themes T3-035 asking a host for space, T3-094 disputing who approves a spot, T3-099 relying on a bigger neighbour and T3-162 vetting others' requests to build moved from T4-018 Meta-organization (5 members left: the coalitions) to T4-014 Territoriality (11 members now), by out/_analysis/c2d_recut_p4.py --recut hosting; both stay in D04; Meta-organization's gloss (physical_removal/c0046) and prose become the coalitions', Territoriality's prose gains hosting; tier_history.jsonl now 470 lines (2 fourth-order lines with was, 4 third-order moves), counted. Why: hosting follows no coalition and comes before one in 12 of 17 rooms, and hosts that give a ground rule on space or design (F-012); the reviewer set hosting beside territory. Next in the same act: the coalition element narrowed, F-008 and F-012 re-examined.
